simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בַּצְלוּת (H1213) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בַּצְלוּת (Batslûwth) means Batsluth or Batslith , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Ezra 2 52.

definitions.full: H1213. Batsluth בַּצְלוּת proper name, masculine ( stripping ) — head of Israel family at return from exile; ׳בניבֿ Ezra 2:52 = Neh 7:54 Kt; בַּצְלִית 7:54 Qr.
definitions.rootNote: or בַּצְלִית ; from the same as 1211 ; a peeling;
